meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计低噪声量子电路,并在谷歌量子处理器上运行实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在量子计算领域做研发,需要设计面向谷歌量子芯片的自定义电路。
copy.tagline_en: Build noise-resilient quantum circuits and run experiments on Google quantum hardware.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're researching quantum and need to run custom circuits on Google chips.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Cirq 帮你用 Python 搭建、模拟和优化量子线路,还能把任务提交到 Google 量子处理器或 IonQ、Azure Quantum 等合作后端,并做噪声建模与线路编译。
howto.when: 当你针对 Google 量子硬件、设计噪声感知线路,或运行量子表征实验时触发;原文建议 IBM 硬件改用 qiskit,量子机器学习用 pennylane。

say.text: 用 Cirq 搭一个两量子比特的贝尔态线路并模拟 1000 次
say.note: 会给出测量结果的直方图。

say.text: 用 Cirq 的密度矩阵模拟器比较不同噪声强度下的线路表现
say.note: 输出各噪声水平的测量统计。

say.text: 用 Cirq 把线路编译到 Google 原生门集再提交运行
say.note: 需已获批准的 GCP 项目权限。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Cirq to build, simulate, and optimize quantum circuits in Python, submit them to Google Quantum AI processors or partner backends like IonQ and Azure Quantum, and model noise.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you target Google quantum hardware, design noise-aware circuits, or run quantum characterization experiments. For IBM hardware the original suggests qiskit.

say_en.text: Use Cirq to build a two-qubit Bell-state circuit and simulate 1000 shots
say_en.note: Returns a histogram of measurement results.

say_en.text: Use Cirq's density matrix simulator to compare noise levels
say_en.note: Reports measurement statistics per noise level.

say_en.text: Compile this circuit to a Google native gateset and submit it
